MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.label: flower decree
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.description: Qinghe's three Flower Decrees. Learning all of them empowers Flower Decree.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.label: divine protection
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.description: Basic upgrades for Qinghe's self-recovering shield and Flower Decree.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.label: divine blessing
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.description: A protective effect triggered when Qinghe suffers fatal damage.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.label: flower dance
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.description: A temporary empowered state activated by spending Flower Decree.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.label: Luoshen Fu
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheSkill.description: Musical intent related to spouses and non-combat cultivation.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: flower decree
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: The initial score group. Qinghe already knows Spring Flow; this node only unlocks the Flower Decree score group.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: soulpiercer
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: Unlocked by "Feihua Jueyu". Creates a sonic burst at a distant target location, stunning targets in the area and dealing psychic damage.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: frost moon mirror
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: Unlocked by "Duanqiao Canxue". Summons a circular ice curtain that freezes and absorbs hostile projectiles passing through it.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: Gaoshan
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: Unlocked by "Gaoshan". Increases Divine Protection shield capacity and Flower Decree maximum.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: Liushui
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: Unlocked by "Liushui". Increases Divine Protection recharge speed.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: Chunjiang
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: Unlocked by "Chunjiang". When Divine Protection takes heavy damage, caps the shield damage from a single hit.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: Yingyue
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: Unlocked by "Yingyue". Increases the available charges of Divine Blessing.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: Nishang Dance
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: Unlocked by "Nishang Dance". Allows Qinghe to spend Flower Decree to enter Flower Dance.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: Jueying
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: Unlocked by "Jueying". Allows Qinghe to use Leaping Shadow, choosing a direction after landing to strike in a cone.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.label: Luoshen Fu
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.MX_QHSkillN.description: Unlocked by "Luoshen Fu". Enables spouse-related Luoshen Fu effects.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheMusic.label: Duanqiao Canxue
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheMusic.description: Unlocks Flower Decree: Frost Moon Mirror.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheMusic.label: Chunjiang
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheMusic.description: Reduces the pressure on Divine Protection when it takes heavy single-hit damage.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheMusic.label: Nishang Dance
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheMusic.description: Unlocks the active empowered state: Flower Dance.

MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheMusic.label: Jueying
MiliraXian.Characters.QingHe.QingheMusic.description: Unlocks the decisive dash technique: Leaping Shadow.
